What if a UFO landed in your backyard?
It's two a.m. Your dog won't stop barking.
A glowing disc sinks over the fence.
It's thirty meters wide. Bigger than your house.
The lawn beneath it flattens into a perfect circle.
Your lights flicker. Your phone loses signal.
Then a ramp slowly lowers to the grass.
Within minutes, the whole street is filming.
Within an hour, soldiers seal off your block.
Scientists scan your soil for radiation.
The nearest star is over four light-years away...
so even light needs four years to get here.
Whoever flew this came a very long way.
Your backyard is now the most famous place on Earth.
So... would you walk up the ramp?
